opportunities.title: Installer-channel flexibility audit and scheduler for Polish prosumers
opportunities.customer: Polish microbusinesses and households that already have PV plus a controllable battery, heat pump or EV charger; renewable installers act as the acquisition and installation channel.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A customer is considering a dynamic-price contract, adding storage, or discovering that exported PV energy and poorly timed loads are producing disappointing economics.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The end customer pays for a read-only 30-day shadow audit; if measured data supports a credible benefit, the customer pays an annual software fee and the installer can earn an integration margin. Payment is tied to delivery of the audit or activation, not assumed regulatory budget.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Start with a software-only audit that combines interval consumption, PV output, equipment constraints and public market signals to simulate safer load schedules. Add opt-in control only for supported devices after shadow-mode validation. Sell direct through installers on a wholesale-plus-subscription model.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Use the founder's family renewable installer as a design partner and first source of consenting customers, then license the same audit workflow to other small installers in Poland and CEE. No camera-led audience is required.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A maintained library of device adapters, tariff rules and consented forecast-versus-actual results could shorten each new deployment and strengthen savings estimates. This is an operating advantage only if device access and reuse rights persist; it is not assumed to be a durable moat.
founder_fit: Direct pilot access through the family renewable-energy company
Strong match for data science, forecasting and automation skills
Read-only MVP is part-time-testable and limits capital and safety downside
Installer channel minimizes repeated founder-led selling

claims.statement: At the end of 2025, 48% of Polish customers had remote-read meters; 4,836 households and about 27,000 small or microbusiness customers used dynamic-price contracts.
Poland had 1,636,673 grid-connected renewable microinstallations at the end of 2025, 99.9% of them photovoltaic, creating a large installed base distinct from the still-small dynamic-tariff segment.
PSE exposes current system and market reports and points integrators to its current API, so a low-cost market-signal prototype is technically plausible.
Installer distribution will make customer acquisition affordable and the scheduler will create enough net savings to support recurring pricing.

contrary_evidence: S1 shows household dynamic-price adoption was still only about 0.03%, so broad demand is not established.
S1 also shows large differences in achieved prices across suppliers, which means an optimizer cannot promise savings merely from switching tariffs.
Equipment APIs are fragmented, and commercial reuse of every relevant price feed must be checked rather than assumed.
unknowns: Which inverter, meter, battery and heat-pump APIs are reliably accessible to a third party
Net savings after battery degradation, comfort constraints, tariffs and software fees
Installer support burden and willingness to share customer relationships
Whether customers will grant interval-data and control permissions
opportunities.validation_test: Recruit 10 consenting customers from the family company's installed base, run a 30-day read-only shadow simulation on two supported device combinations, and ask for a signed paid continuation before building control. Pass only if at least three customers pay and measured, constraint-adjusted savings exceed the proposed annual fee by a clearly disclosed margin; otherwise keep it as an audit service or stop.

opportunities.title: Cross-DSO grid-connection pre-screen for PV, storage and electrification sites
opportunities.customer: Polish renewable developers, engineering offices, land brokers and installers screening 50 kW to 1 MW generation, storage or high-load projects before committing engineering and application expense.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A customer is considering a site or preparing a grid-connection application but has fragmented operator data and a high risk of spending on a location with little practical connection capacity.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The developer or engineering office pays per site-screening report before a land option or connection application, then can subscribe for portfolio monitoring and change alerts.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Normalize public DSO capacity tables, planned changes, issued conditions and refusal evidence into a geocoded evidence pack. Provide a transparent risk heuristic and checklist, never a promise of connection. Sell fixed-fee reports first and a data subscription only after repeated demand.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Pilot on opportunities encountered by the family installer, then reach engineering offices and regional land or energy developers with sample evidence packs for named substations.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A versioned cross-DSO schema, station-name resolution and a history of published changes can reduce future research time and support back-testing. The public data itself is not a moat, and predictive value must be demonstrated against later decisions.
founder_fit: Data normalization and geospatial scoring suit the founder's technical background
Family ecosystem can provide real application questions without forcing a large build
Reports can be produced asynchronously with limited meetings
A data product can expand nationally if the initial report wedge works

claims.statement: The URE 2025 report records 2,881 refusals for renewable generation totaling about 29.46 GW across the five named large distribution operators, evidence that connection screening is a material problem rather than a hypothetical one.
TAURON states that Polish Energy Law requires publication of aggregate available connection capacity and planned changes for the next five years, broken down by relevant stations or station groups.
A normalized pre-screen will reduce wasted site-development expenditure enough to command a meaningful per-site fee.

contrary_evidence: Published capacity is not a reservation and can change before an application is decided.
A refusal can depend on project-specific technical and economic conditions that a public-data heuristic cannot observe.
Some developers already employ grid specialists or maintain proprietary operator relationships.
unknowns: Consistency, update frequency and reuse terms across all Polish DSOs
Ability to geocode station groups accurately enough for site decisions
Average avoidable pre-application cost and willingness to pay
Whether historical decisions can be linked to prior published capacity for back-testing
opportunities.validation_test: Build one manually verified atlas for two DSO territories and back-test 30 historical applications supplied by consenting engineering partners. Sell three fixed-fee site reports before automating national coverage; require buyers to rate whether the report changed a go, no-go or data-request decision.

opportunities.title: Czyste Powietrze dossier QA for auditors and renovation contractors
opportunities.customer: Independent energy auditors and legitimate insulation, HVAC and heat-pump contractors preparing technical and commercial inputs for Czyste Powietrze applications; the product does not present itself as an official programme operator.
opportunities.problem_trigger: An audit, scope, quote and equipment list have been assembled and need a rules, arithmetic and evidence check before the beneficiary works with the municipality or WFOŚiGW operator.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The auditor or contractor pays per checked dossier or a monthly team subscription when a report identifies exceptions and produces a versioned evidence checklist before submission.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: A document-ingestion QA tool reconciles audit recommendations, required energy standard, quantities, unit limits, equipment eligibility and quote fields, then returns traceable exceptions for a human professional to resolve. It is compliance support, not official operator service or an eligibility guarantee.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Use de-identified historical packs from the family business and one collaborating auditor to build the checklist, then sell through regional auditor and contractor networks in Wielkopolska.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A versioned rule library and a consented taxonomy of real dossier defects could improve checking speed. Frequent programme changes are both the reason for the service and a maintenance cost; no moat is assumed from storing documents.
founder_fit: Family company can expose real workflow friction and supply a bounded pilot
Document extraction and deterministic checks fit AI-assisted data work
Per-dossier work can begin part-time with low capital
The founder can avoid acting as the public-facing salesperson or official adviser

claims.statement: An energy audit has been mandatory in the reformed Czyste Powietrze programme since 31 March 2025, and the post-work energy standard must be evidenced by an energy certificate.
As of 13 March 2026, 1,401 municipalities, about 57% of Polish municipalities, acted as programme operators, and official operator help is free to residents.
Auditors and contractors will pay for pre-submission QA even though beneficiaries can obtain free official operator assistance.

contrary_evidence: S6 says official operators provide free help, which may eliminate consumer willingness to pay and reduce contractor demand.
Only municipalities and WFOŚiGW are official operators; a private product must not imply that status.
Programme rules and eligible measures can change, creating legal and maintenance risk.
unknowns: Observed defect, correction and rejection rates in real dossiers
Which source documents are consistently available in machine-readable form
Whether auditors or contractors own the budget and perceive enough saved rework
Professional liability boundaries and required human review
opportunities.validation_test: With permission, blind-check 20 de-identified completed dossiers against the rule version that applied at submission, compare findings with actual correction requests, and then offer five paid prospective checks at a fixed fee. Stop if the tool cannot find material issues reliably or buyers prefer the free operator workflow.

opportunities.title: Low-noise public-tender radar for small energy contractors
opportunities.customer: Polish small and midsize PV, HVAC, electrical, insulation and energy-efficiency contractors that lack a dedicated bid desk.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A relevant municipality, school, housing or commercial-energy tender is published, amended or approaching deadline, but generic alerts either miss it or create too much review work.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor pays a monthly subscription for a human-auditable shortlist and evidence checklist; an optional fixed fee applies when the customer requests a structured bid/no-bid dossier, not a guaranteed win.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Ingest BZP and TED notices, classify by work type, geography, reference requirements and deadline, detect amendments, and produce a concise fit explanation plus missing-evidence checklist. Start as a productized analyst service and automate only stable steps.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Have the family company label relevant and irrelevant notices to tune the first filter, then recruit similar contractors via supplier directories and regional trade associations using sample alerts rather than a personal media brand.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: Customer-specific relevance labels and recorded bid outcomes can improve ranking for that customer and adjacent niches. This advantage depends on enough feedback and does not make the underlying public notices proprietary.
founder_fit: Immediate access to a realistic contractor design partner
Strong fit for classification, retrieval and workflow automation
Asynchronous subscription service limits constant interaction
Can validate demand before building a full tender platform

claims.statement: Poland's e-Zamowienia platform exposes national BZP notices and statistics through an API without requiring an integration procedure.
The EU TED Search API allows unauthenticated search and bulk XML retrieval of published procurement notices and explicitly supports commercial value-added reuse.
A vertical filter trained on contractor-specific constraints will be materially more useful than existing generic tender portals.

contrary_evidence: The same open APIs support incumbent and new tender-alert competitors.
Relevant notices may still require references, bonds, site visits and procurement expertise that a radar cannot supply.
The family company may not bid often enough to prove recurring willingness to pay.
unknowns: Number of genuinely addressable tenders per contractor per month
Incumbent pricing and switching friction
Whether better filtering changes bid volume or win rate
Completeness and stability of attachments and amendment links
opportunities.validation_test: Have the family company label 100 recent notices, run a six-week live alert for it and nine comparable contractors, and request payment after week two for continued delivery. Require at least three paying users plus evidence that the shortlist prompted a qualified bid or saved documented review time.

opportunities.title: KSeF offline-queue and reconciliation control for accounting offices
opportunities.customer: Polish accounting offices and multi-system SMEs that already have invoice software but need an independent control over KSeF receipts, offline invoices, acknowledgements and ERP or bank reconciliation.
opportunities.problem_trigger: An invoice is created or received during normal, offline24, maintenance or outage handling and finance staff must prove that it reached KSeF on time, was not duplicated and matches internal records.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The accounting office or finance team pays per connected tax entity each month after a sandbox proof and reconciliation report; a one-time onboarding fee covers mappings and permissions.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: A read-only exception monitor imports KSeF status and internal invoice identifiers, flags missing UPO or KSeF numbers, duplicate documents, overdue offline sends and receipt gaps, and exports a close checklist. It complements rather than replaces invoicing software.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Sell first through two accounting offices that can aggregate many end clients, using the official test environment and an offline or self-hosted option for sensitive data.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: Reusable ERP mappings, exception rules and a test corpus of non-sensitive failure cases can lower onboarding cost. Incumbent ERP vendors can replicate features, so speed and neutrality across systems matter more than data possession.
founder_fit: Structured-data reconciliation fits the founder's data and finance orientation
Accounting-office distribution aggregates customers and reduces repeated selling
A read-only monitor is safer than becoming the system of record
Official test APIs enable a low-capital MVP

claims.statement: KSeF receipt became mandatory from 1 February 2026; mandatory issuance began for the largest taxpayers on that date and for most others on 1 April 2026, with a temporary small-invoice exception through 2026.
KSeF has several offline procedures with different deadlines and document-delivery or QR rules, creating exception states that must be tracked.
The Ministry publishes KSeF 2.0 OpenAPI contracts and integration environments, making an independent monitor technically testable.
Accounting offices will buy an independent control layer rather than rely on their ERP and free government applications.

contrary_evidence: The Ministry offers free KSeF applications, and established ERP or accounting vendors can add similar controls.
The product handles tax-sensitive data and could create liability if users treat alerts as tax advice.
The 2026 exception regime means not every invoice belongs in KSeF, increasing false-positive risk.
unknowns: Real exception rates after the first implementation wave
API permissions and throttling for accounting offices serving many taxpayers
Security requirements and preference for self-hosting
Price that is lower than avoided reconciliation labor yet supports integration
opportunities.validation_test: Build against the official integration environment, simulate all published offline states, and run a read-only four-week pilot with one accounting office and two SMEs. Compare alerts with manual close, measure minutes saved and false positives, and require a paid per-entity renewal before adding another ERP connector.

opportunities.title: SKU-to-BDO packaging mass reconciliation for importers and ecommerce
opportunities.customer: Polish ecommerce sellers, importers and small brands that place packaged goods on the market and must aggregate packaging or product data for BDO reporting.
opportunities.problem_trigger: Monthly or annual reporting approaches and the company has sales and purchasing data but packaging weights live in supplier files, spreadsheets and SKU notes that do not reconcile cleanly.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The business or its environmental-compliance adviser pays an onboarding fee to build a packaging bill of materials and a recurring fee for monthly reconciliation and a year-end BDO-ready export.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Map each SKU and bundle to packaging materials and weights, ingest order or KSeF exports, flag missing or implausible mappings, produce an audit trail, and push or export approved values for BDO. A named human remains responsible for filings.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Partner with boutique BDO advisers and accounting offices that already hold the customer relationship; acquire the first pilot from a Warsaw importer or ecommerce operator with a manageable catalog.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: Reusable supplier and packaging-component mappings can reduce work across a customer's catalog and, with explicit rights, across common suppliers. The value comes from verified mappings and workflow integration, not an assumed data moat.
founder_fit: Data cleaning and reconciliation are core founder strengths
Monthly asynchronous processing is compatible with a full-time job
A narrow catalog pilot requires little capital
Advisor channels can reduce high-energy direct sales

claims.statement: The official BDO system provides API-key functionality intended to integrate a reporting entity's account with external systems.
The 2025 product, packaging and waste report was due electronically in BDO by 15 March 2026, showing a recurring filing event rather than a one-off transition.
Joining sales data to a verified packaging bill of materials will reduce manual reporting work and corrections for small importers.

contrary_evidence: Invoices generally do not contain packaging mass, so automation still depends on initial supplier and SKU data work.
BDO provides free instructions and training, while compliance consultants already prepare filings.
Polish packaging and EPR rules are evolving, which could change fields and buyer workflows.
unknowns: How many target SMEs have enough SKUs or volume to justify software
Whether third-party advisers can use BDO API access on a client's behalf
Quality and stability of packaging weight data from suppliers
Error rates, correction costs and willingness to pay
opportunities.validation_test: For one consenting importer with 100 to 500 active SKUs, reconstruct the prior reporting year from order exports and a manually verified packaging table, compare totals with the filed report, and price a monthly continuation. Proceed only if reconciliation finds material gaps or saves enough documented hours for the buyer to sign a paid renewal.

opportunities.title: CBAM supplier-data QA desk for mid-market importers
opportunities.customer: Polish and CEE importers just above the CBAM mass threshold in iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity or hydrogen, especially firms without an internal carbon-accounting team.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A new supplier or shipment enters scope and the importer must obtain, validate and preserve embedded-emissions evidence before authorization, declaration and certificate obligations become costly or urgent.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The importer pays per supplier onboarding or per quarterly data-quality pack, then an annual fee for declaration-ready evidence. A customs broker can resell the service; regulatory liability stays contractually with the declarant and qualified advisers.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Ingest customs lines and Commission supplier templates, identify in-scope goods, chase missing fields through structured multilingual forms, run consistency checks against methods and defaults, and maintain a versioned evidence trail. Begin as a productized managed service before building self-service software.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Partner with customs brokers, freight forwarders and trade associations that can identify threshold-crossing importers at the paid event, avoiding mass consumer marketing.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A permissioned library of supplier identities, plant-method mappings and recurring validation exceptions can make repeat onboarding cheaper. Cross-customer reuse may be restricted and is not assumed to create a moat.
founder_fit: Combines quantitative data validation with finance and regulation
Supplier-document workflows can be heavily automated and asynchronous
A single paid supplier pilot is possible without significant capital
Channel partners can carry relationship-heavy acquisition

claims.statement: The definitive CBAM regime applies from 1 January 2026; importers above a single 50-tonne mass threshold must seek authorized-declarant status, declare embedded emissions and surrender corresponding certificates.
Supplier evidence quality and repeated data collection will be painful enough for threshold-crossing mid-market importers to outsource QA.
The number of accessible Polish importers above threshold and their service budget are not established by the regulatory source.

contrary_evidence: The 50-tonne threshold removes many small importers from the obligation.
The Commission provides official guidance, registry tools, default values and templates, and customs brokers may bundle assistance.
Incorrect classification or emissions calculations can create material compliance exposure beyond a software founder's competence.
unknowns: Polish importer counts and shipment frequency by covered sector above 50 tonnes
Share of suppliers able to provide usable plant-level data
Broker partnership economics and incumbent competition
Required insurance, expert sign-off and liability limits
opportunities.validation_test: Interview five customs brokers and ten threshold-crossing importers in two covered sectors, then complete one fixed-fee historical supplier-data QA pack using the customer's own shipment and evidence files. Continue only if the buyer pays for the next live supplier or quarter and a qualified adviser accepts the responsibility split.

opportunities.title: DORA contract-to-register compiler for non-micro financial entities
opportunities.customer: Small but non-micro Polish payment institutions, insurers, asset managers, lenders and other DORA-scope financial entities whose ICT contracts and service dependencies are still tracked across documents and spreadsheets.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A supervisory reporting cycle, vendor onboarding, contract change or internal audit requires an up-to-date register of all ICT third-party arrangements at the required entity and group levels.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The regulated entity pays for a secure one-time register build and validation, then a recurring fee when contracts or service dependencies change and for each reporting-ready export.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Run locally or in a controlled environment, extract contract parties and service facts, map functions and subcontractor chains to official templates, expose every uncertain field for human approval, execute official validation rules, and produce change logs. Do not provide legal conclusions automatically.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Co-sell through Polish compliance consultancies, internal-audit boutiques and regulatory-reporting integrators that already advise in-scope entities.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A robust contract-to-template ontology and validated parsing tests can lower future implementation effort. Contracts remain customer-confidential, so advantage must come from tooling and workflow quality rather than pooling client data.
founder_fit: Document extraction, entity resolution and validation suit the founder's data skills
Finance interest helps with the buyer's context
A secure project-based wedge can be tested before SaaS investment
Consultancy channels reduce founder-led networking load

claims.statement: DORA became applicable on 17 January 2025, and financial entities in scope must maintain a comprehensive register of contractual arrangements with ICT third-party providers at entity, sub-consolidated and consolidated levels.
The EBA supplies official data models, templates, validation rules and reporting packages, making deterministic compilation and validation technically bounded.
Contract extraction will materially reduce compliance cost for smaller in-scope entities that do not already own a DORA platform.

contrary_evidence: Large regtech, governance and consulting vendors already serve DORA compliance.
Proportionality and scope details may make the smallest or simplest prospects unattractive.
Sensitive contracts and security review can lengthen sales and prevent a cloud deployment.
unknowns: Count of Polish in-scope entities underserved by incumbents
Typical register size, error rate and annual maintenance effort
Procurement cycle and preference for on-premise processing
Accuracy achievable on Polish-language and amended contracts
opportunities.validation_test: Compile the official template from synthetic contracts first, then seek eight interviews through two compliance partners and one paid, local-processing pilot on a redacted contract set. Pass only if official validation succeeds, human reviewers confirm field-level traceability, and the entity buys an update cycle.

opportunities.title: AI Act transparency regression scanner for chatbots and synthetic media
opportunities.customer: Polish SaaS companies, agencies and mid-market firms deploying customer-facing chatbots or automated synthetic-content pipelines in the EU.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A chatbot, model, interface or content pipeline changes and the owner needs continuing evidence that users receive the required AI disclosure and generated or altered media carries the expected labels or machine-readable marks.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The deployer or its digital agency pays for an initial public-surface audit and a monthly regression monitor when the service records a change, missing disclosure or broken mark and produces an evidence snapshot.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Crawl only authorized public test paths, inspect disclosure language and machine-readable metadata, run scripted interaction checks, retain dated screenshots or response evidence, and route legal-scope questions to counsel. Sell a fixed audit first and recurring monitoring second.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Identify prospects from public chatbot surfaces, offer a concise evidence-based audit through web and software agencies, and let agencies resell the monitor across client portfolios.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A test library across frameworks, languages and content formats can improve coverage and reduce false alarms. Regulations and codes are public, so execution reliability rather than data accumulation would be the advantage.
founder_fit: Direct fit with AI systems, automated testing and evidence capture
Public-surface audits are part-time-testable without deep integration
Agency resale reduces repeated high-energy sales
No personal brand or camera presence is needed

claims.statement: From 2 August 2026, EU AI Act transparency rules require covered chatbots to tell users they are interacting with AI and require labels or machine-readable marks for covered generated or altered content.
Regression monitoring is a recurring operational need rather than a one-time legal memo for firms that ship interface and model changes frequently.
The exact number of Polish deployers in scope and their budget for a standalone scanner are unknown.

contrary_evidence: Model and platform vendors may build default labels and provenance marks into their products.
Whether a particular system or item is legally covered can require contextual legal analysis that a scanner cannot replace.
Generic accessibility, privacy and AI-governance scanners can add similar checks.
unknowns: Machine-readable formats and browser-observable tests accepted in practice
National enforcement priorities and demand outside high-profile use cases
False-positive rates across Polish language interfaces
Agency willingness to resell rather than build simple checks internally
opportunities.validation_test: With authorization, audit 30 public Polish chatbot or synthetic-content surfaces, provide ten deployers a one-page finding, and offer a paid 60-day regression monitor. Require three paid monitors and at least one detected post-deployment regression before expanding to broader AI governance.

opportunities.title: EUDAMED UDI record QA and bulk-onboarding service
opportunities.customer: Small Polish and CEE medical-device manufacturers, authorized representatives and importers with multiple devices or legacy records but no dedicated EUDAMED data team.
opportunities.problem_trigger: An actor, device, UDI or certificate record must be registered, migrated or corrected after mandatory EUDAMED use began, and spreadsheet or portal entry risks inconsistent identifiers and rejected records.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The economic operator pays per batch of validated records and migration, then a maintenance fee for new devices and change monitoring. Payment occurs on delivery of a validated upload pack, not on a promise of regulatory approval.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Clean and reconcile actor, Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device, nomenclature and certificate fields, validate cross-record consistency, and prepare portal or machine-to-machine uploads with an audit trail. Pair the software with a qualified regulatory consultant for judgment calls.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Reach manufacturers through Polish medtech clusters, notified-body and regulatory-consultant referrals, and public EUDAMED records; start with one narrow device class and one partner consultant.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A tested mapping library for common source systems and device families can reduce migration time. Public records and rules are not proprietary, and confidential client data should remain segregated.
founder_fit: Health interest and medical access improve domain learning
Identifier reconciliation and bulk validation match data-science skills
Batch onboarding is measurable and can start as a part-time service
Consultant referral channels reduce continuous social selling

claims.statement: Actor, UDI/device, notified-body and certificate, and market-surveillance EUDAMED modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026; vigilance and clinical-investigation modules remain under development.
The Commission publishes EUDAMED machine-to-machine, public API and technical-onboarding resources, so bulk-data tooling has an official integration path.
Smaller operators have enough migration and data-quality pain to buy a specialized batch service instead of using the free portal or an existing consultant.

contrary_evidence: EUDAMED provides a free portal, user guides and onboarding materials.
Established regulatory consultants and quality-management vendors already serve manufacturers.
The remaining modules are not yet mandatory, so a broad all-module platform would be premature.
unknowns: Number of addressable Polish and CEE operators and devices needing migration
Machine-to-machine access conditions for a third-party service provider
Typical rejection or correction causes and batch size
Required regulatory credentials, insurance and liability allocation
opportunities.validation_test: Use the public API and documentation to build a 20-record validation prototype, interview ten Polish manufacturers or authorized representatives through one regulatory partner, and sell one fixed-fee sandbox or controlled batch migration. Continue only if the client validates time saved and buys maintenance for subsequent records.

opportunities.title: Poland and CEE clinical-trial site feasibility intelligence
opportunities.customer: Small and midsize CRO business-development teams, sponsors and clinical-trial site networks choosing Polish or CEE sites for a new protocol.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A protocol enters country and site feasibility, and teams need to see competing active trials, sponsor patterns, recruitment status and normalized site identities before sending broad questionnaires.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: A CRO or sponsor pays for a protocol-specific country and site landscape before outreach; a site network can subscribe to therapeutic-area and competitor alerts.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: Resolve public CTIS sponsors and site names, map therapeutic areas and recruitment windows, show competition density and evidence provenance, and deliver a ranked research pack that clearly separates public facts from inferred site fit. Start with analyst reports, then subscription data.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Approach CRO feasibility leads and Polish Clinical Trials Support Centres with one high-quality therapeutic-area sample; use direct written outreach and partner referrals rather than conferences or a personal brand.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A maintained site-identity graph and tracked changes can reduce repeated cleaning. Public CTIS data does not reveal enrollment performance, so any stronger ranking requires customer-supplied outcomes and must be validated rather than presumed.
founder_fit: Combines health, neuroscience and entity-resolution skills
Public-data report can be built and tested part-time
High-value B2B deliverables may support a small customer count
Asynchronous research minimizes continuous interaction

claims.statement: CTIS makes trial identifiers, therapeutic area, sponsor details and recruitment or trial dates publicly viewable, and revised transparency rules have applied since June 2024.
ABM reported that the CTIS map contained 1,945 trials at 1,251 Polish sites as of 22 May 2025, providing enough records for a Poland-focused entity-resolution wedge.
Normalized competition and site-identity intelligence will improve feasibility decisions enough to command protocol-level fees.

contrary_evidence: EMA already provides a public trial portal and multilingual clinical-trial map.
Public CTIS records do not establish site enrollment speed, data quality, investigator availability or budget.
Large CROs and sponsors already own feasibility systems and private performance data.
unknowns: Permitted and technically stable method for repeated structured extraction
Accuracy of site entity resolution across languages and sponsor-entered names
Which small CRO or sponsor segment lacks incumbent tooling
Price and procurement cycle for protocol-specific reports
opportunities.validation_test: For one therapeutic area, manually verify a 25-site Poland and CEE landscape and show it to five CRO feasibility or site-network leads. Ask for a paid report tied to one upcoming protocol; do not build a platform unless at least one buyer pays and identifies a decision changed by the evidence.

opportunities.title: EEG-BIDS conversion plus reproducible QC packs for labs and neurotech
opportunities.customer: University EEG labs, small neurotechnology or BCI companies and research CROs that collect EEG but lack dedicated data-engineering support for reusable, auditable datasets.
opportunities.problem_trigger: A study is preparing for analysis, collaboration, publication, model training or handoff and discovers inconsistent formats, missing metadata, artifact uncertainty and non-reproducible preprocessing.
opportunities.payer_and_paid_event: The lab or company pays per dataset for conversion, metadata repair and a reproducible QC report; repeat teams can license a self-hosted pipeline plus support. Payment is for an accepted data pack, not scientific findings.
opportunities.offer_and_business_model: A privacy-preserving productized service inventories raw formats, converts to EEG-BIDS, runs validator and deterministic signal-quality metrics, produces an exception report, and delivers containerized preprocessing recipes. Begin with non-clinical research data and avoid diagnostic claims.
opportunities.distribution_mechanism: Publish technical sample reports from open datasets, conduct direct written outreach to Polish and CEE labs and neurotech firms, and seek referrals from equipment distributors or research-methods consultants.
opportunities.compounding_advantage: A tested adapter library for acquisition systems, study paradigms and artifact metrics plus consented aggregate QC benchmarks can shorten future jobs. The open standard and tools remain available to everyone, so this is not presumed defensibility.
founder_fit: Direct leverage of neuroscience, EEG and data-science education
Open datasets allow a rigorous portfolio before accessing client data
Dataset projects are asynchronous and part-time compatible
Can evolve from service cash flow into a pipeline product

claims.statement: EEG-BIDS standardizes EEG data and metadata for interoperability, and its authors note that even a simple EEG processing pipeline contains eight steps and remains non-trivial to automate reproducibly.
A free guided tool, ezBIDS, already lowers BIDS-conversion barriers and offers validation, providing direct contrary evidence to a conversion-only product.
Customers will pay for domain-specific EEG QC, privacy-preserving deployment and accepted handoff packs beyond what free conversion tools provide.

contrary_evidence: S23 documents a free guided standardization tool, while MNE-BIDS, EEGLAB and validators are open source.
Academic budgets and procurement can be small and slow, and the global EEG-lab market may remain niche.
Quality metrics vary by paradigm and hardware, limiting one-click generalization.
unknowns: Frequency and value of outsourced EEG data-cleaning projects
Which hardware formats and paradigms have the highest unmet pain
Data-transfer, ethics and privacy requirements for human-subject recordings
Whether neurotech firms prefer hiring internally or buying a self-hosted tool
opportunities.validation_test: Create end-to-end packs for five open EEG datasets spanning at least three raw formats and two paradigms, publish methods and before-after QC evidence, and approach ten labs or neurotech teams. Require two paid dataset pilots with acceptance criteria before adding a UI or clinical features.
